title: API keys
subtitle: Keys authenticate applications against the /v1 API. Every key belongs to a project or a person of a company, or internally to you.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Connect a provider, add a model, then create an API key. After that, try the Playground.

empty: Create a key to start routing traffic through the gateway.
secretHint: This is the only time the full key is shown.

fields.templatesHint: Template rules stay current as models change. <link>Manage templates</link>
fields.modelsHint: Allowed in addition to the selected templates.
fields.maxRequestCostHint: Requests whose estimated cost (input tokens plus max_tokens at the output price) exceeds this amount are rejected before forwarding. Callers can lower it per request with the x-hub-max-cost header. 0 is unlimited.
fields.allowedIpsHint: One IP address per line. Leave empty to allow any address.
fields.endpointsHint: Leave empty to allow every endpoint. The model list (/v1/models) always stays available.
fields.logContentHint: When off, request logs for this key keep only metadata, no prompts or responses.

windows.title: Allowed times
windows.hint: Without time windows, the key works at any time. With windows, requests outside all of them are rejected. Queued batches still finish.
